specialist.name: Mathyou
specialist.resume: Hi, I'm Mathyou. I handle everyday math and practical comparisons like date differences and distance comparisons with unit conversions.
specialist.exampleRequest: Compare two dates and tell me which is later, then compare 5 miles vs 8 kilometers.

script.description: Safely evaluates a math expression with basic arithmetic operators.

arguments.argument: Math expression using numbers, parentheses, and operators: +, -, *, /, //, %, ** (example: (3 + 5) * 2.5).

script.output: JSON object with fields: expression, result.

script.description: Compares two ISO dates/datetimes and returns which is earlier or later plus the difference.
script.output: JSON object with fields: date_a, date_b, relation, difference_days, difference_hours, difference_seconds.

script.description: Adds or subtracts whole days from an ISO date/datetime.

arguments.argument: Integer number of days to add (negative to subtract).

script.output: JSON object with fields: input_date, days_added, result_iso, result_date.

script.description: Adds mixed offsets (days, hours, minutes) to an ISO datetime.
script.output: JSON object with fields: input_datetime, offset{days,hours,minutes}, result_iso, result_date, result_time.

script.description: Compares two distances, normalizes units to meters, and reports which is larger.

arguments.argument: Unit for A: mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi.
Unit for B: mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi.

script.output: JSON object with fields: a_meters, b_meters, relation, difference_meters, larger, smaller.
